newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich strengthens Hong Kong position.
newsitem.headline: Zurich strengthens Hong Kong position.

text.p: Zurich Insurance Co. said it was strengthening its position in Hong Kong by buying back the 25 percent stake in Zurich Insurance Co. (Asia) held by Swire Insurance Holdings Ltd., a subsidiary of Swire Pacific Ltd.
Zurich will also acquire a 35 percent stake in Wing Hang Swire Insurance Co. Ltd. and various local holding, management and distributing companies, the company said in a statement.
Zurich will also acquire Swire Pacific's 60 percent interest in Paofoong Insurance Co. Ltd. Hong Kong.
Subject to approvals by local authorities and the respective boards, the acquisition will take effect on January 1.
The company did not provide a purchase price.
The total premium volume of the former Swire Insurance companies amounted to some U.S. $10 million in 1996 and that of Zurich Insurance Co (Asia) of some $30 million.
Zurich said this move strengthened its position in Hong Kong considerably, adding this area would become strategically important for the south Chinese market after July 1.
Zurich has been represented in China since 1993 with an office in Beijing and since mid-1996 also in Shanghai.
